## 2. COMPLETE INSURANCE SERVICES OFFERED

### A. COMMERCIAL & INDUSTRIAL INSURANCE (Specialty)

**Motor / Vehicle (Commercial)**
- Commercial vehicle insurance (lorry, truck, tanker, tipper, trailer, bus)
- Fleet insurance (bulk renewal, multi-vehicle management, claim coordination)
- Goods carrier insurance
- Passenger vehicle insurance (staff transport, school bus)
- Three-wheeler / auto-rickshaw insurance

**Industrial / Factory / Warehouse**
- Standard Fire & Special Perils (SFSP)
- Industrial All Risk (IAR)
- Warehouse / godown insurance (stock, fire, burglary)
- Factory insurance (machinery, building, stock)
- Stock declaration policies
- Machinery Breakdown (MBD)
- Boiler & pressure plant insurance
- Electronic equipment insurance
- Mining & heavy industrial insurance (quarries, mineral processing, heavy equipment)
- Land & property insurance (building, under-construction, commercial property)

**Marine & Cargo**
- Marine cargo insurance (inland, import, export)
- Goods-in-Transit (GIT) insurance
- Marine hull & inland vessel insurance
- Import & export cargo insurance (customs-hold, multi-leg transit, documentation)
- Open cover / annual policies for regular shippers

**Construction & Contractor**
- Contractor All Risk (CAR)
- Erection All Risk (EAR)
- Workmen Compensation (WC)
- Crane, earthmover & heavy equipment insurance (CPM)
- Third-party liability (construction sites)

**Liability**
- Public liability insurance (industrial / non-industrial)
- Product liability insurance
- Professional indemnity insurance
- Directors & Officers (D&O) liability
- Employer's liability

**Business Packages**
- Shop insurance / shopkeeper's policy
- Office / SME package policies (office & commercial property package)
- Business interruption insurance / loss of profit
- Burglary insurance
- Money insurance
- Fidelity guarantee insurance

### B. PERSONAL & FAMILY INSURANCE

**Motor (Private)**
- Car insurance (comprehensive, third-party, standalone OD)
- Two-wheeler / bike insurance
- Add-ons: Zero depreciation, RSA, engine protect, NCB protect, return to invoice

**Health**
- Individual health insurance / mediclaim
- Family floater health insurance
- Senior citizen health insurance
- Critical illness cover
- Personal accident insurance
- Group health insurance (corporate / employee)
- Top-up & super top-up plans

**Life (LIC)**
- LIC endowment policies
- LIC term insurance
- LIC pension / retirement plans
- LIC servicing and renewal support
- LIC claim documentation guidance
- Term life insurance (plan selection, premium comparison across LIC & term plans)

**Other Personal**
- Home insurance (building structure + contents)
- Travel insurance (domestic + international)
- Domestic helpers insurance

## 3. WHY THIS AGENCY (COMPETITIVE ADVANTAGES)

### vs. Large Brokers (PurplePond, Ensign, Alert, etc.)
| Factor | Rajendrakumar | Large Brokers |
|--------|---------------|---------------|
| Personal attention | One expert, end-to-end | Team-based, may change |
| Doorstep service | Yes, anywhere in Chennai | Usually office-based |
| Claim involvement | Personally handles | Structured but less personal |
| Pricing | Competitive (multi-insurer) | Often higher overhead |
| Commercial expertise | 30+ years ground-level | Corporate-structured |
| Response time | 24/7, immediate | Business hours typically |
| Accountability | Direct — one person | Department-based |

### vs. Online Aggregators (PolicyBazaar, Coverfox, etc.)
| Factor | Rajendrakumar | Online Aggregators |
|--------|---------------|---------------------|
| Claim support | Full personal involvement | Minimal/none |
| Documentation guidance | Proactive before purchase | Rarely done |
| On-site support | Yes | No |
| Policy understanding | Explained in person | Self-service |
| Post-purchase service | Lifelong relationship | Transaction-only |

### Key Strengths (What Makes This Agency Stand Out)
1. **Claim-first approach** — checks documentation, disclosures, and proof
   discipline BEFORE selling the policy. This reduces claim rejections.
2. **30+ years of real claim experience** — knows exactly what insurers
   verify, why claims get rejected, and how to avoid common pitfalls
3. **Doorstep service across Chennai** — no need to visit any office
4. **Multi-insurer comparison** — not tied to one company
5. **Affordable** — competitive pricing without broker markups
6. **24/7 WhatsApp support** — send policy docs anytime for instant review
7. **No lead-selling** — your information stays private
8. **All insurance types** — commercial AND personal (car, bike, health, life)

## 8. CONTENT PHILOSOPHY

- Content is process-driven, not promotional
- Explains what insurers verify, why claims fail, how to prepare
- Limitations stated clearly — no false promises
- Focus on documentation discipline and claim-readiness
- Trust built by explaining constraints, not making guarantees
